run_generate_data_local: run synthetic data generation locally using vLLM inference with a prompt column and specified model
run_generate_data_slurm: run synthetic data generation on a Slurm cluster with distributed vLLM inference across multiple GPUs
run_generate_data_template: run synthetic data generation using a prompt template with [[DOCUMENT]] variable substitution
run_generate_data_multinode: run synthetic data generation across multiple nodes with tensor and pipeline parallelism
run_generate_data_benchmark: run synthetic data generation in benchmark mode skipping output writing for performance testing
